title: Sable and the Cover
author: Mara Winterbourne
blurb: Coral Delacroix, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, works cases no one wants attributed. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
